# nizima LIVE sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Change nizima LIVE model

Swaps your model for another one from nizima LIVE's model list, for example a different outfit.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Change to** | The model to change to, as in nizima LIVE's model list. |
| **Instead of** | Which model on screen to swap. Leave empty for the selected one. |

<small>Type id: `nizima.changeModel`</small>

## Hide nizima LIVE item

Takes an item off the screen again. Every item with that name goes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The item's name. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.removed%` | How many items were taken off |

<small>Type id: `nizima.removeItem`</small>

## nizima LIVE effect on/off

Turns one of your nizima LIVE effects on or off, like sparkles or a colour filter.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Effect** | The effect's name, as in nizima LIVE's effect list. |
| **State** | On, Off, or Toggle (the opposite of now). Options: On, Off, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.effectOn%` | True when the effect is now on |

<small>Type id: `nizima.effect`</small>

## nizima LIVE expression on/off

Turns one of your model's expressions on or off, like a smile, blush or angry face.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model** | Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one; most people have only one. |
| **Expression** | The expression's name, as nizima LIVE shows it. Connect first to pick from the list. |
| **State** | On, Off, or Toggle (the opposite of now). Options: On, Off, Toggle. Starts as: `On`. |
| **Turn the other expressions off first** | Tick to turn every other expression off first, so only this one shows. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.expressionOn%` | True when the expression is now on |

<small>Type id: `nizima.expression`</small>

## nizima LIVE expressions off

Turns all of the model's expressions off, back to its normal face.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model** | Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one. |

<small>Type id: `nizima.clearExpressions`</small>

## Play nizima LIVE motion

Plays one of your model's motions, like a wave or a bow.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model** | Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one. |
| **Motion** | The motion's name, as nizima LIVE shows it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.motion%` | The name of the motion that played |

<small>Type id: `nizima.motion`</small>

## Press nizima LIVE hotkey

Presses one of the hotkeys you set up for your model in nizima LIVE, so anything a hotkey can do, an action can do too.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model** | Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one. |
| **Hotkey** | The hotkey written the way nizima LIVE shows it, for example F1 or Ctrl+A. |

<small>Type id: `nizima.hotkey`</small>

## Show nizima LIVE item

Puts an item from your nizima LIVE item list on screen, like a hat, a sign or a pet.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The item's name, as in nizima LIVE's item list. |
| **Next to model** | Which model's window to add it to. Leave empty for the selected model. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%nizima.itemId%` | nizima LIVE's number for the new item |

<small>Type id: `nizima.addItem`</small>

## Stop nizima LIVE motion

Stops the motion the model is playing.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model** | Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one. |

<small>Type id: `nizima.stopMotion`</small>
